title: helianthemum apenninum subsp. violaceum
intro: Helianthemum apenninum subsp. violaceum, commonly known as Purple Rockrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Helianthemum apenninum subsp. violaceum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
